name: serialized-values-stored-in-typed-slots
description: A value stored in a slot of a serialized type is serialized at its own static type, because the serializer emits the value the slot holds: a subtype stored where the slot's type names a supertype, a value stored in a variable annotated with an alias of unknown, and a value a destructuring assignment stores, from a literal or from the part of a typed value the pattern names. A value of the destructured source the pattern does not take is not serialized, so its member stays reported.
